newsitem.title: PERU: Lima shares end down on fears of U.S. rate hike.
newsitem.headline: Lima shares end down on fears of U.S. rate hike.

text.p: Lima stocks closed slightly lower on a technical correction of blue chip prices and fears of a hike in U.S. interest rates, brokers said.
"The market dropped due to corrections in the prices of some leading shares and also on fears of a rise in interest rates in the United States," said Jose Cervantes of Investa brokerage.
He said the market is expected to behave in a similar fashion until March 25, when the U.S. Federal Reserve's policymaking committee meets on interest rates.
